attempts.resolution: Follow the actually exposed target with precision fire; stop only after verified paid fourth-protocol replacement and both desired protocols are equipped. Both real synergies and active retest victory remain required.

memoryConclusion.statement: The saved ten-active-minute run passed its frame-budget and pressure checks. Sampled used heap settles into a broadly similar post-warmup envelope; backing storage is narrow and embedder heap fluctuates without a rising later median. Total V8 heap capacity still rises in later windows, so this evidence does not establish a total-memory plateau or absence of leaks. Script copy, current script, game bundle, recorded build inputs and terminal survival are verified separately below.
